summary: Reproduced the loss of a second complete GLM-4.7 tool call in one final streaming increment. The parser now drains every complete buffered tool call with a progress check while retaining an incomplete suffix. Added regressions for two no-argument calls, two argument-bearing calls, and a complete call followed by a partial call.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, only tool index 0 was emitted and '<tool_call>second</tool_call>' remained in the detector buffer; after the fix, both tool indices 0 and 1 were emitted and the buffer was empty. Raw outputs are in failing-before.log and passing-after.log.
All 15 GLM-4.7 detector unit tests passed, including the three new final-increment and partial-boundary regressions.
All 29 related GLM-4 and GLM-4.7 parser tests passed.
All configured repository checks applicable to the changed source, tests, and reproduction script passed.

gpu_execution_evidence: The defect is deterministic CPU-only parsing of already generated text; no model execution, numerical GPU kernel, compiler, or ISA claim is involved.
remaining_limitations: No GLM-4.7 model weights or serving-path model reproduction was used; validation is limited to the actual streaming detector implementation and parser unit tests.
No GPU execution was relevant to this text parser defect.
